responsibility: Implements dispatch for builtin Rust derive expansion. This file provides DeriveVisitor construction support and the central derive(Item&, Attribute&, BuiltinMacro) selector that maps recognized builtin derive names such as Clone and Copy to their concrete expander classes, while routing unsupported derive targets to diagnostics, making it the coordinator between #[derive(...)] handling in macro expansion and per-trait synthesis files.
same_name_distinction: Provides the shared derive dispatcher that selects which builtin derive implementation to invoke, such as DeriveClone or DeriveCopy. Unlike rust-derive.h, which defines the abstract framework, this .cc is the coordination point that maps builtin derive names to concrete expander classes.
